source_note: Hand maintained. The TigerCenter payload exposes no usable category: catId, mapId and mrkId are 0 on all 24 locations and department is 'Dining' for every one of them. The summary field is free text and inconsistent (one location's summary is literally 'MON/015 - 1030'), so it cannot be parsed either. Categories therefore live here rather than being string matched in the client.
